# pattern symmetric, 5 x 5: the matrix scipy.io.mmread reads from
# scipy/coordinate_pattern_symmetric.mtx (scipy 1.18.0), by gen_matrix_market.py.
# Each nonzero cell: row and column from 0, the bits of the real and the imaginary
# part as f64, and the bits of the two parts of the nearest f32 to each number of
# the file (a cell named twice summed in f32), all in hexadecimal. The values of a
# file that isn't complex have the imaginary part +0.
